profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full Stack Software Engineer with a unique background and a proven track record of driving impactful projects in code and culture. Proficient in Typescript/Javascript, Python, React, Vue, and Django with a deep understanding of GitHub Actions and DevOps and Agile methodologies. Recognized for excellent documentation skills and fostering effective collaboration among diverse teams.

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Extended and productized a frontend React/Typescript MVP
- Contributed to backend APIs
- Created GitOps workflows for frontend and infrastructure deployment
- Backfilled administration of Azure Cloud infrastructure
- Architected an ML-Ops pipeline to normalize training data, track datasets and models, and deploy model improvements to production
- Mentored junior developers
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · TypeScript · Django · ML Ops · Docker · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Principal Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Spearheading a greenfield SaaS FinOps product focused on AI/ML insights
• Architecting microservice application stacks with AWS Infrastructure as Code
• Writing a responsive, highly tested Vue frontend 
• Writing APIs using OpenAPI 3.0 spec as source of truth with Python lambdas
• Created a CI/CD pipeline
• Writing over half the code on a team of 4 engineers

Co-Chairing the 100+ member Application Development Community of Practice
• Leading meetings, coordinating presenters, facilitating participation
• Co-wrote curriculum on TDD, Trunk Based Development, Type Safety, Clean Code

Technical lead on yearlong UI modernization project with US/India team  
• Decomposed Django MVC app into an API-driven Vue app
• Mentored 4 juniors, 3 promoted, 1 inherited tech leadership
• Scoped epics/stories, steered roadmap 
• Improved API speed/flexibility for new presentation use-cases
• Praised for documentation thoroughness and processes

Conceived/implemented customer-focused extension framework
• Enabled using industry standards to extend frontend 
• Replaced difficult-to-maintain extension framework
• Leveraged existing capabilities to avoid heavy rewrite
• GitHub template repo with Vue wrappers, scripts, docs
• High customer praise driving adoption/sales/upsales

Created internal cross-platform CLI for dev/test environments
• Shortened environment switching from 6 hours to 5 minutes 
• Simplified 12-step process to single command using Docker
• Adopted company-wide by developers, support, QA

Core code contributor across Django APIs, AWS microservices
• Pivoted across stacks, teams, cloud providers daily
• Contributed to AWS, GCP, Azure integrations 
• Wrote high-coverage tests
• Extensive code reviews
• Led "Bug Bash" efforts

positions.description: Provided short-term software engineering expertise to global clients within an exclusive network. Successfully executed diverse projects, such as porting the Oodle compression algorithm from C# to Javascript, parsing compressed and encrypted XML files for data analysis, and constructing an administrator dashboard for an overseas real estate platform.

positions.description: Crafted and owned software and electronics solutions for Animatronics and art installations, serving clients such as Disney, Wynn, Universal Studios, and Broadway. Led diverse projects, including an autonomous water drone control system, intricate lighting displays, multi-ton motion control platforms, and drive-by-wire vehicles.
